21 CFR 700.3(b) (eCFR, binding, verbatim): (b) The term cosmetic product means a finished cosmetic the manufacture of which has been completed. Any cosmetic product which is also a drug or device or component thereof is also subject to the requirements of Chapter V of the act [5].
21 CFR 710.9(a) (eCFR, binding, verbatim): (a) Beauty shops, cosmetologists, retailers, pharmacies, and other persons and organizations that compound cosmetic products at a single location and administer, dispense, or distribute them at retail from that location and who do not otherwise manufacture or package cosmetic products at that location [2].
21 CFR 710.9(b) (eCFR, binding, verbatim): (b) Physicians, hospitals, clinics, and public health agencies [3].
21 CFR 710.9(c) (eCFR, binding, verbatim): (c) Persons who manufacture, prepare, compound, or process cosmetic products solely for use in research, pilot plant production, teaching, or chemical analysis, and who do not sell these products [4].
